# lago_coupon (Resource)

Manages a Lago coupon.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    lago = {
      source  = "registry.opentofu.org/rpcpool/lago"
      version = ">= 0.1.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "lago" {
  api_endpoint = var.lago_api_endpoint
  api_key      = var.lago_api_key
}

# Fixed-amount coupon with a time limit
resource "lago_coupon" "fixed_discount" {
  name        = "New Customer Discount"
  code        = "new_customer_50"
  description = "50 USD off for new customers"

  coupon_type     = "fixed_amount"
  amount_cents    = 5000
  amount_currency = "USD"

  expiration    = "time_limit"
  expiration_at = "2025-12-31T23:59:59Z"

  frequency = "once"
  reusable  = false
}

# Percentage coupon with recurring frequency limited to specific plans
resource "lago_coupon" "percentage_recurring" {
  name = "Loyalty 10% Off"
  code = "loyalty_10pct"

  coupon_type     = "percentage"
  percentage_rate = 10.0

  expiration = "no_expiration"

  frequency          = "recurring"
  frequency_duration = 3
  reusable           = true

  plan_codes = ["starter_plan", "pro_plan"]
}

variable "lago_api_endpoint" {
  type = string
}

variable "lago_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `code` (String) Unique coupon code. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `coupon_type` (String) Coupon type. Allowed values: `fixed_amount`, `percentage`.
- `expiration` (String) Expiration strategy. Allowed values: `time_limit`, `no_expiration`.
- `frequency` (String) Frequency at which the coupon is applied. Allowed values: `once`, `recurring`.
- `name` (String) Coupon name.

### Optional

- `amount_cents` (Number) Discount amount in cents. Required when `coupon_type` is `fixed_amount`.
- `amount_currency` (String) Currency code for the discount amount (e.g. `USD`). Required when `coupon_type` is `fixed_amount`.
- `billable_metric_codes` (Set of String) List of billable metric codes this coupon is limited to.
- `description` (String) Coupon description.
- `expiration_at` (String) Expiration date and time (RFC3339). Required when `expiration` is `time_limit`.
- `frequency_duration` (Number) Number of billing periods the coupon applies to. Required when `frequency` is `recurring`.
- `percentage_rate` (Number) Discount percentage rate (e.g. `15.0` for 15%). Required when `coupon_type` is `percentage`.
- `plan_codes` (Set of String) List of plan codes this coupon is limited to. If empty, the coupon applies to all plans.
- `reusable` (Boolean) Whether the coupon can be applied multiple times to the same customer.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Coupon creation timestamp (RFC3339).
- `id` (String) Terraform resource ID, set to the coupon code.
- `lago_id` (String) Lago internal UUID for the coupon.
